verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a hosted auth and user-management SaaS like Clerk, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of choosing a storage region or data-residency location. The only related mention is a community comment that a competitor (Better Auth) stores auth data in your own database, which says nothing about Clerk offering region choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
